title: Hussain hai Namaz me
body:
HUSSAIN ASWS. HAIN NAMAZ MEIN..**2.
ASH-HADU ANNAKA QAD AQAMTASSALAAT,,,, WA AATAITAZZAKAAT,,,, WA AMARTA BIL MA'ROOF,,,, WA NAHAITA ANIL MUNKAR,,,, WA ATAA'TALLAAHA WA RASOOLAHU HATTAAA ATAAAKAL YAQEEEN,,,, SHAHADAT'ON KE ARSH PAR...... LUTAKE APNA SAARA GHAR-- HUSSAIN ASWS. HAIN NAMAZ MEIN.
KUL AMBIYA KI HAIN NAZAR.... HAI BANDAGI UROOJ PAR-- HUSSAIN ASWS. HAI NAMAZ MEIN.
1. NISHAAN E HAQ HAR EK TARAF-- JAHAN MEIN JAGMAGAYEGA..*2
HAZAR KOSHISHEIN HO PAR--KOI MITAA NA PAAYEGA..*2
RAHEGA JAARI HASHR TAK...QUDA JJH. KE DEEN KA SAFAR-- HUSSAIN ASWS. HAI NAMAZ MEIN.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. NA ZAQM AA SAKE KOI --IBADAT E HUSSAIN ASWS. MEIN..**2.
SAEED A.S. AUR ZUHAIR A.S. HAIN-- HIFAZAT E HUSSAIN ASWS. MEIN..**2.
NAMAZ E NUSRAT E HUSSAIN ASWS..... PADHTE HAIN YEH SONCHKAR--HUSSAIN ASWS. HAI NAMAZ MEIN.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. HAI TEEN(3) DIN KI PYAAS MEIN--YEH SAJDA E SHAHE HUDA**2.
YAQEE'N DILA RAHA HAIN AB--JAHA'N KO RAB KI ZAAT KA**2.
NIGAHO'N MEIN ANDHERA HAI.....BADAN HAI QOO'N MEIN TAR-BATAR-- HUSSAIN ASWS. HAI NAMAZ MEIN.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. HAR EK TARAF SE WAAR HAI--AJAB SITAM KA HAI SAMAA'N**2.
NABI SAWW. KA NOOR E AIN HAI-- SITAMGARO KE DARMIYAA'N**2.
KISI NE MAARE TEER AUR..... KOI LAGATA HAIN TABAR-- HUSSAIN ASWS. HAI NAMAZ MEIN.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. QUDA JJH. KA TUJHKO WAASTA-- NABI SAWW. KA TUJHKO WAASTA--**2.
YEH GOONJTI HAI DASHT MEIN-- SADAAYE BINTE FATIMA S.A.**2.
NA KAAT SAR HUSSAIN ASWS. KA....QUDA JJH. KA QOUF SHIMR L.A. KAR-- HUSSAIN ASWS. HAIN NAMAZ MEIN.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. CHURI GALE PA CHAL RAHI HAI-- MUSTAFA SAWW. KI JAAN KE**2.
BADAN MEIN TEER SAINKDO'N-- HAI EK NAATAWAAN KE**2.
HAI AASMAAN GHAMZADA.......ZAMEEN BHI HAI NOUHAGAR-- HUSSAIN ASWS. HAIN NAMAZ MEIN.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. BAYAAN KAR RAHA HAI YEH-- WAJOOD AALAMEEN KA**2.
NAMAZ MEIN YEH KEH RAHA HAI-- LAFZ SWAALEHEEN KA**2.
NAMAZ HAI HUSSAIN ASWS. SE.... NAMAZIYON KO DO QABAR-- HUSSAIN ASWS. HAIN NAMAZ MEIN.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. JAHAN SE FIKR HAI JUDA-- YEH AJMAL O KAMAAL KI**2.
TAMAM UMR DEHER MEIN-- KAHEGI BAZME ASGHARI**2.
HUSSAIN ASWS. KE KARAM SE HAI..... YEH NAUHA KITNA PUR ASAR--- HUSSAIN ASWS. HAIN NAMAZ MEIN.
Kalaam: JANAB MOHSIN KAMAAL SAHAB QIBLA-O- JANAB MIR JAFFER ALI SAHAB(AJMAL)
